notes: People can now have locally uploaded profile photos (PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, or WebP).
Optional per-person Gravatar support is opt-in and used only when no local profile photo exists.
People without a photo use a polished initials avatar fallback.
Profile avatars appear in the People list and Person detail view.
Updater code is unchanged from 1.1.12.7 so this release can validate the new self-update/reconnect flow.
